title: Connecting and fusing the power supply
body_md: Connect pin 1 and pin 8 with the correct polarity to a suitable power supply of 12 V DC. Secure the positive cable with the enclosed fuse. Pins 2 to 5 are measurement inputs for voltages from 0 to 30 V. Depending on the operating mode, geofencing can also be activated via pin 3.
prev_context: The table of operating modes ends on the previous page.
next_context: The connection of the alarm system follows.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 11: equivalent in substance, including 12 V DC and the measurement range of 0 to 30 V. Both versions name the fuse without a rating; the 3 A value appears only in the scope of supply. “Suitable power supply” remains undefined in both and stands alongside the 9 to 30 V range of the technical data (DSC-069).
